verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt documents a REST API that creates notarization requests for an uploaded document, lets businesses manage signers, auto-detects signature fields with AI, and sends HMAC-signed webhooks on completion. An agent could therefore route an existing document through a notarized signing flow programmatically. Nothing in the evidence covers drafting or generating an NDA, an MCP server, or ordinary e-signature routing as opposed to notarization. Missing for 10: NDA drafting or template generation, an official MCP server, plain e-signature routing outside notarization, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
